summary: Iter90: Alquileres occupation vs previous year. Backend: 22/22 existing ocupacion tests pass (comparativa + iter89 + base), and 7/7 new edge-case tests pass (negative, zero, previous-year block shrinking the denominator, createdAt boundary month, Dec/Jan year crossing, 400 validation, general aggregation excluding properties with null). UI verified with a TEST_ property whose createdAt was set back: in the property panel MAR shows a green up arrow +32.2pts, MAY a red down arrow 51.6pts, JUL '0.0pts' with no icon; A161 shows 's/d' in all 12 months (expected). The general panel shows the 'VS. 2025:' row, the year selector updates it to 'VS. 2024', and the detail table, average and chart still work. The mobile layout (390px) wraps cleanly. One logic issue in the general aggregation: the current pct uses the whole portfolio, but pctAnterior uses only properties that can be compared, so the general variacion is misleading.

minor.issue: variacion = pct (ALL properties, including new ones with null comparison) - pctAnterior (only comparable properties). The two sides use different property sets. Reproduced: an old property went 20%->10% (-10pts) and a new property had 20 nights; general showed pct=25.6, pctAnterior=20.0, variacion=+5.6 (green) when the like-for-like change was -10. Live preview: general JAN shows +11.3pts and JUL -8.0pts even though the only comparable property had 0.0 in both months (the difference comes from A161, created in 2026). Fix: also add up ocupadas/disponibles for the current period only over rows where disponiblesAnterior is not null (e.g. t['ocupadasCmp'], t['disponiblesCmp']), and compute variacion = pctCmp - pct_ant. Keep 'pct' as the full-portfolio value for the chart.

createdAt is compared only by month (mes_prev < createdAt[:7]). A property created mid-month (e.g. 2025-11-20) is compared against that partial month using a full-month denominator, which shows an artificially low pctAnterior. Edge case, low priority.
A property's disponibles is counted even for months before its createdAt, which dilutes the portfolio pct for past years (e.g. 2025 counts A161 as 0% even though it did not exist yet). Low priority.

issues: Bars were not visible in a screenshot taken right after load (mount animation); they rendered on the next load. Not a bug.

action_items: In ocupacion_general, compute general variacion like-for-like: add up the current ocupadas/disponibles only for property-months where the previous-year comparison is not null, and subtract pctAnterior from that value (keep pct for the chart). Optionally return pctComparable.
Optional: treat the createdAt month itself as 's/d' (or use day precision) so a partial first month is not used as a comparison baseline.
